title: Grade 3 Math — Choosing Operations in Word Problems
subject: Math
description: Practice with questions on addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, two steps.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Four bags hold 8 markers each. How many markers are in all?
A team has 50 points and loses 17. How many points remain?
Mia shares 27 shells evenly among 3 friends. How many does each get?
A bus has 38 seats. Twenty-nine are taken. How many are open?
Five tables each seat 6 children. Four chairs are empty. How many children are seated?
Jules read 29 pages on Monday and 38 on Tuesday. How many pages altogether?
A coach splits 48 players between 8 teams. Two players from each team bring flags. How many players bring flags?
Ana makes 3 rows of 9 paper stars. She gives away 12. How many remain?
A 7-foot path is extended by 5 feet. How many feet long is it now?
There are 36 photos and 4 pages. Put the same number on every page. How many go on each?
A class raises 21 dollars, then 35 more. It spends 8 dollars. How many dollars remain?
A jar holds 5 red and 7 blue beads. Each of 4 identical jars holds the same amounts. How many blue beads in all?
There are 8 bags with 6 limes each. The limes are split between 2 baskets. How many go in each basket?
A shop had 80 tickets. It sold 6 groups of 7 tickets. How many remain?
Lena folds 15 planes. Dev folds twice as many. How many planes did they fold together?
A 9-meter ribbon is joined with a 15-meter ribbon. The new ribbon is cut into 3 equal lengths. How long is each, in meters?
Two classes each collect 24 books. Nine books are damaged. How many undamaged books are there?
A library has 64 books on 8 equal shelves. How many books are on three shelves together?
A garden has four rows. Two rows have 7 plants and two rows have 5 plants. How many plants are there?
Nora has 30 beads. She spends 4 beads on each of 7 bracelets. How many beads are left?
